displayName: Azure SQL: Enforce Azure AD-only authentication (administrators alias)
description: Denies Microsoft.Sql/servers whose administrators.azureADOnlyAuthentication is not true. Complements deny-azure-sql-aad-only-authentication (which targets the azureADOnlyAuthentications child) by catching the server administrators write path. MCSB v2 IM-1.1, PA-7.1.
